title: HSDS + provenance/freshness JSON Schema + TS types + ajv validation
context: food-assistance-maps adopts Open Referral HSDS as its canonical schema (per ADR #1) extended with Elyos provenance and freshness fields. The schema is the front door of the data pipeline: every published entry must validate against it before publication, and the schema must structurally preclude recipient/client PII. Depends on food-maps-arch-002 (the ADRs) being completed first — the schema is provisional until ADR #1 and ADR #2 land.
objective: Publish a JSON Schema (draft-07) for the HSDS core (organization, service, location, schedule, service_area, contact) plus the Elyos provenance/freshness extension (sources[], verification_method, verified_by, last_verified, reverify_due, confidence, operating_status, pii_review, data_license, reviewLogRef), TypeScript/ESM types generated from the schema, and an ajv-based build-time validator that rejects entries missing required provenance/verification/license fields and rejects any recipient-PII-shaped field.
acceptanceCriteria: JSON Schema covers HSDS core: organization, service, location, schedule, service_area, and public contact fields

Schema includes all Elyos provenance/freshness extension fields: sources[], verification_method, verified_by, last_verified, reverify_due, confidence, operating_status, pii_review, data_license, reviewLogRef
No recipient/client fields (name, DOB, benefits, household, income) are representable in the schema
Build-time ajv validator rejects an entry missing any required provenance or verification field
Build-time validator rejects an entry containing any recipient-PII-shaped field (enforced by additionalProperties: false or an explicit deny list)
TypeScript/ESM types are generated from or consistent with the JSON Schema and pass typecheck
Schema is marked provisional until ADR #1 and ADR #2 are recorded; schema file references those ADRs
Unit tests cover at least: a valid entry passes, a missing last_verified fails, a missing sources[] fails, a recipient-PII field fails
output: packages/schema/src/food-assistance-entry.schema.json (JSON Schema) + packages/schema/src/types.ts (TS types) + packages/schema/src/validate.ts (ajv validator) with passing unit tests.
